mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing clobazam metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while clobazam may induce isoniazid metabolism through CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for increased clobazam side effects (sedation, dizziness, ataxia); consider clobazam dose reduction if toxicity occurs; monitor isoniazid efficacy and adjust dosing if needed.
